item.title: Employment protection legislation in OECD countries
item.description: Employment protection legislation in OECD countries A picture of the evolution of the OECD employment protection legislation index for regular contracts, using the Version 4 summary indicator for individual and collective dismissals (EPRC) on the OECD 0–6 scale. This indicator does not measure employment outcomes directly. It measures the relative strictness of dismissal regulation: the higher the value, the stricter the protection written into legislation and related rules. A simple measure gives a first idea of the phenomenon.
